title: Split ledger helpers and add balance reconciliation
body:
## Summary

This splits the grab-bag `util` and `report` modules and adds a reconciliation pass to the ledger engine.

- Moves `render_table` into a new `format` module and tidies its output with a column separator.
- Moves the hashing helpers into `hash`, unchanged.
- Renames `legacy` to `compat` and trims header lines when detecting the v1 format.
- Adds `Ledger::reconcile`, which lists accounts whose balance differs from an expected map.
- Raises the batch `LIMIT` from 100 to 250.

## Testing

```sh
cargo test -p ledger
```

See the [design notes](https://example.com/ledger/design) for why reconciliation lives in the engine.
